title: SVGs and 30-second music clips joined the API
summary:
A format-expanding day: SVG vectors and music clips arrived, image models got sturdier routes, and community models became more visible.

Pollinations can now generate real SVG vector artwork with Recraft, including text-to-SVG and single-reference-image requests through the image and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Lyria 3 Clip also landed, producing verified 30-second stereo MP3s through GET and OpenAI-compatible audio requests. Pixels were apparently not enough formats.

NanoBanana, NanoBanana 2, NanoBanana 2 Lite, NanoBanana Pro, and Seedream Pro now run through pinned OpenRouter provider routes while keeping their existing aliases, editing flows, reference-image support, resolution controls, caching, EXIF behavior, and content-policy responses. NanoBanana 2 and Pro retain direct 4K generation, while Seedream keeps its 2K and 4K presets.

The Flux Klein worker now caps requests at a tested 2.36-megapixel area, uses a more resilient CUDA allocator setup, clears cache after out-of-memory events, and returns controlled responses for oversized work. Supported large formats such as 1536×1536 and 2048×1152 get a steadier worker instead of an opportunity to discover GPU limits the dramatic way.
